summary: Most seams and compatibility claims are valid, but batch-grammar ownership and creator-close rebind were missing before RED.

findings.title: applicationBatch logical-time grammar has no owner across the issuance-store package boundary
findings.remediation: Make issuance-store own a closed local grammar parser and pin its result against a real Node-assembled batch.

findings.title: Fresh-handle settlement recovery never rebinds creator-close authority
findings.remediation: Rebind through existing bindCurrentCreatorClose and retain the existing terminal rebind-failure disposition.

findings.title: Room keeps a pre-existing duplicate Node batch budget and grammar
findings.remediation: Treat it as an accepted behaviorally pinned compatibility seam, not a new threshold owner.

findings.title: Separated recovery must construct a fresh admission policy
findings.remediation: Construct a fresh policy for every recoverV3LiveReplica call.

findings.title: Workspace dependency edge is new, not existing
findings.remediation: Describe it as one new direct edge to the existing workspace package.
